body:
# Octaves of the One

A Fabric tech mod for Minecraft **1.21.4**, themed on **Walter Russell's cosmology** — the *two-way universe* of **rhythmic balanced interchange**. Draw **Light** from the still centre of zero, wind it up through the octaves by **generation** (compression), pour it back out by **radiation** (expansion), and spend it across a wired *and* wireless grid to run machines, fly, farm, and transmute matter.

> Light is **carried, not consumed**. The cosmology is flavour, not physics — but every block maps to one of Russell's ideas, so the tech tree reads as a working model of his system.

## The loop, end to end

Everything is craftable from scratch in survival, and the in-game **Great Work advancement tree** guides you through it step by step.

- **Mine & refine** — Echocite ore → Echo Ingot, the core of every recipe. Drumstone and Silentite (Deep Dark) add further branches.
- **Generate Light** — the Resonant Coil winds ambient sound into stored Light; the Stillness Core trickles it from rest; the Octave Coil and Storm Caller power the late game.
- **Carry & bank** — Wave Conduits move Light on a network with fair, no-starvation distribution; Resonance Cells bank it; the Balancer keeps cells even.
- **Spend it** — the Compressor doubles ore, the Transmuter smelts with no fuel, and the radiation family (Growth/Warmth Radiator, Polarity Field) pours Light back into the world. The Resonant Thrusters give look-direction flight.
- **Go wireless** — tune devices to a shared channel and beam items, fluids, and Light with no conduit: the Wave Relay and a full family of channel gadgets.
- **Transmute** — every item has a **Light Value**; the Transmutation Table is your personal Bound-Light account: dissolve matter to bank it, withdraw Mote coins, or condense anything you've attuned.
- **Build the garden** — the glowing Lumewood set, Lumebloom, Lume Lantern, Echocite Bricks, and Verdant Loam.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.4** (Fabric) · **Fabric API** (required) · Java **21**
